start.text: Luna the unicorn wakes up on a sunny morning. Where should she go today?

a.text: In the forest, a little squirrel waves hello. It looks like it needs help!

b.text: At the beach, Luna finds a little sailboat. The sea sparkles!

aa.text: Together they find a mountain of acorns! The squirrel is so thankful. What now?

ab.text: Luna is the best hider in the forest! All the animals want more fun.

ba.text: A friendly whale swims beside the boat and winks at Luna!

bb.text: The sandcastle is magnificent, and a little crab wants to be its king!

end_party.text: The whole forest comes to Luna's acorn party! What a wonderful day. The End!

end_rainbow.text: Luna slides all the way home on a rainbow. Sweet dreams, Luna! The End!

end_crown.text: The animals crown Luna the Hide-and-Seek Champion of the forest! The End!

end_pearl.text: The whale shows Luna a glowing pearl — a gift for her bravery! The End!

end_crab.text: King Crab rules the grandest sandcastle on the beach. Long live the king! The End!

end_bonfire.text: Everyone dances around the bonfire until the stars come out. The End!

start.text: Pip the puppy found a treasure map! Where does the trail begin?

a.text: Sniff sniff! The trail leads through the sunflowers. Pip hears a sound...

b.text: The map shows the park! Where should Pip look first?

aa.text: Pip digs up a mysterious little chest! It rattles. Should he...

ab.text: The sound was three tiny kittens! They look hungry and a little lost.

ba.text: Wheee! At the bottom waits a shiny golden ball. It starts to roll away!

bb.text: Inside the old oak lives a family of glowing fireflies! They swirl around Pip.

end_biscuits.text: The chest is full of golden biscuits! Best treasure a puppy ever found. The End!

end_share.text: Pip shares his treasure with all his friends. Sharing is the best treasure! The End!

end_kittens.text: Pip leads the kittens safely home. Their mama purrs a big thank-you! The End!

end_ball.text: Pip catches the golden ball with a super jump! Champion Pip! The End!

end_game.text: Pip and his friends play until sunset. A treasure of a day! The End!

end_fireflies.text: The fireflies lead Pip to a secret glowing garden. Magic! The End!

start.text: Milo must fetch grandma's key from the old house on the hill. The wind whispers his name...

scare.reveal: Just an old crow! It was sleeping in the bush. Keep going, Milo...

a.text: The hallway is dark and TOO quiet. Something is scratching inside the closet... it knows Milo is there.

scare.reveal: A soggy raccoon! 'Sorry,' he sniffles, 'I was cold.' He points upstairs with his tail.

b.text: In the garden, the fog moves like it's alive. The cellar door groans open by itself. Something breathes down there.

scare.reveal: Three hedgehogs in one scarf! They were hiding from the storm. The smallest one giggles.

aa.text: Upstairs, a music box plays all by itself... and the door at the end of the hall is RATTLING.

ab.text: In the library the whispers are LOUD now. The big chair creaks. Something's tail twitches behind it...

scare.reveal: The whisperers are owls! It's their midnight book club. 'Shhh,' says the owl, smiling.

ba.text: The cellar glows with a hundred little jars. But on the wall — a HUGE monster shadow rises!

scare.reveal: The giant monster is... a tiny chef mouse and his candle! He offers Milo blackberry jam.

bb.text: The greenhouse plants sway... but there is no wind. And that tall white shape was NOT there before.

scare.reveal: A heron in a bedsheet! 'I am the Garden Phantom!' she announces proudly. Nobody is scared.

end_family.text: Milo and Great-Grandcat share midnight tea and stories until the storm passes. The End!

end_key.text: Milo found grandma's key! And as he leaves... something in the window waves goodbye. The End?

end_owls.text: Milo stays for owl story time. The spooky house isn't spooky at all — just full of readers. The End!

end_feast.text: A midnight jam feast with Chef Mouse! Milo's whiskers are purple with blackberry. The End!

end_phantom.text: The Garden Phantom leads a midnight parade, and Milo is the lantern-bearer. The End!

start.text: It's Mo's first day at Scare School — where little monsters learn to be scary. Mo is NOT scary. Yet.

scare.reveal: RAAH! Hee hee! 'Thorry,' lisps Fangsley through his teeth. 'Firtht-day tradition!'

a.text: In Scaring Class, everyone practices their scary face. Mo's scary face just looks... adorable. The supply closet wobbles.

b.text: Lunch is worm spaghetti and eyeball pudding (it's just grapes). Something under the lunch counter is giggling...

scare.reveal: Sir Stretch was folded under there ALL MORNING waiting! 'Worth it,' he says, un-crumpling.

aa.text: The Scary Talent Show! Every monster did a big scare. Now it's Mo's turn. The gym goes silent... the curtain behind Mo ripples.

ab.text: Blobbina's secret: 'Being scary is just being YOU, but louder.' The funhouse mirror behind them darkens...

scare.reveal: It's just Principal Growlbert on juice break! His shadow is scarier than he is. 'Carry on!'

ba.text: Mo wins the noodle-arm contest by becoming the ball! But the pudding cart is rolling away by itself...

bb.text: The Twins can't agree whose scare is best. They ask Mo to judge. Behind them, the trash can tiptoes away...

scare.reveal: Trash-can Blobbina! Both Twin heads agree for the FIRST TIME EVER: that was the best scare.

end_boo.text: Mo whispers the tiniest 'boo' ever... and the whole school faints — from laughing! Scariest Sound trophy: MO! The End!

end_team.text: Scares are better together! Mo and the whole class take a bow. Best first day ever. The End!

end_growl.text: Mo scares the PRINCIPAL! Growlbert laughs so hard his glasses fog up. Instant legend. The End!

end_pudding.text: The Great Pudding Party of Scare School! Even the lunch pot is laughing. The End!
